run_worker_executor: run the worker executor to process HuggingFace dataset jobs from a MongoDB queue
create_job_runner_factory: create a job runner factory that dispatches dataset processing jobs to appropriate job runners
configure_app_config: configure the worker application settings from environment variables
start_worker_loop: start the worker loop process that polls and processes queued dataset jobs
start_web_app: start the web app providing healthcheck and metrics endpoints for the worker
